newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Philips to further loosen ties with Grundig.
newsitem.headline: Philips to further loosen ties with Grundig.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Wednesday it had decided to further loosen ties with its loss-making German unit Grundig, becoming what it described as a "passive shareholder".
Philips said that given the globalisation of the electronics market, it had decided to start using a single brand name where possible, particularly in the sound and vision markets.
In the United States, Philips has already started to implement this policy, with the introduction of the combined brand name Philips-Magnavox.
"The next step is to implement this policy in Europe with the result that the Grundig brand name is no longer of vital importance to Philips," it said in a statement.
Philips holds a 32 percent stake in Grundig but had managed the company under an agreement with the Max Grundig Foundation.
It did not mention in its statement whether it would reduce this stake at some point in the future.
But Philips said it had started negotiations to unwind the contractural relationship between Philips and the Foundation.
